entries.title: Matthew 18:1
segments: At that hour his disciples came to Jesus and asked him, "Who is really greatest in the kingdom of heaven?"

entries.title: Matthew 18:2
segments: When he had called a little child to him, Jesus set him among them, and answered:

entries.title: Matthew 18:3
segments: "In solemn truth I tell you that unless you turn and become like little children, you will not even enter the kingdom of heaven.

entries.title: Matthew 18:4
segments: "Whoever therefore will humble himself like this little child, is greatest in the kingdom of heaven;

entries.title: Matthew 18:5
segments: "and whoever receives one such little child for my sake, receives me.

entries.title: Matthew 18:6
segments: "But whoever shall cause one of these little ones who believe in me to stumble, it would be better for him if a great millstone were hung about his neck, and he were drowned in the depths of the sea.

entries.title: Matthew 18:7
segments: "Woe unto the world because of such stumbling-blocks! They will surely come, but woe unto each man by whom they come!

entries.title: Matthew 18:8
segments: "If your hand or your foot causes you to stumble, cut it off and cast it from you. It is better for you to enter into life maimed or crippled, than to keep both hands or both feet and be cast into the everlasting burning.

entries.title: Matthew 18:9
segments: "If your eye keeps causing you to stumble, pluck it out and cast it from you. It is better for you to enter into life with only one eye, than to keep both eyes and be cast into the Gehenna of fire.

entries.title: Matthew 18:10
segments: "See to it that you never despise one of these little ones, for I tell you that in heaven their angels do always behold the face of my Father in heaven.

entries.title: Matthew 18:11
segments: "For the Son of man is come to seek and to save that which was lost.

entries.title: Matthew 18:12
segments: "How does it seem to you, when a man has a hundred sheep and loses one of them? Will he not leave the ninety and nine on the hills, to go and search for the one that has strayed?

entries.title: Matthew 18:13
segments: "And if he succeeds in finding it, I tell you solemnly that he rejoices over it more than over the ninety and nine that never strayed away.

entries.title: Matthew 18:14
segments: "Just so, it is not the will of my Father in heaven that one of these little ones should perish.

entries.title: Matthew 18:15
segments: "If your brother sins against you, go and show him, between yourself and him alone. If he listens, you have won your brother.

entries.title: Matthew 18:16
segments: "But if he will not listen to you, take one or two others along, so that by the testimony of two or three witnesses every word may be established. If he will not listen to them, tell the church;

entries.title: Matthew 18:17
segments: "but if he will not heed the church, let him be to you as a Gentile or a tax-gatherer.

entries.title: Matthew 18:18
segments: "I tell you all in solemn truth that whatever you forbid upon earth will be forbidden in heaven, and whatever you permit on earth will be permitted in heaven.

entries.title: Matthew 18:19
segments: "And again I tell you that if two of you on earth symphonize your praying concerning anything for which you have asked, it shall be done for you by my Father in heaven.

entries.title: Matthew 18:20
segments: "For wherever there are two or three gathered together in my name, there am I among them."

entries.title: Matthew 18:21
segments: Just then Peter came to him, and asked him, "Lord, how often shall my brother sin against me, and I forgive him? till seven times?"

entries.title: Matthew 18:22
segments: "I do not tell you 'till seven times,'" answered Jesus, "but till seventy times seven.

entries.title: Matthew 18:23
segments: "Thus the kingdom of heaven may be compared to a king who wished to settle accounts with his slaves.

entries.title: Matthew 18:24
segments: "But when he began to settle, one of them was brought before him who owed him fifteen million dollars.

entries.title: Matthew 18:25
segments: "And since he was unable to pay, his master ordered him to be sold, and his wife and children and all that he had, toward the payment of the debt.

entries.title: Matthew 18:26
segments: "Thereupon his slave threw himself on his knees before him, crying, "'Have patience with me, and I will pay you all!'

entries.title: Matthew 18:27
segments: "So then the master pitied his slave, and let him go, and forgave him his debt.

entries.title: Matthew 18:28
segments: "But on his way out, that slave met a fellow slave who owed him fifty dollars. Seizing him by the throat, and nearly choking him, he exclaimed, "'Pay me what you owe me!'

entries.title: Matthew 18:29
segments: "Then his fellow slave fell at his feet, and besought him, saying, "'Be patient with me, and I will pay you.'

entries.title: Matthew 18:30
segments: "But he would not; on the contrary he went and threw him into prison until he should pay the debt.

entries.title: Matthew 18:31
segments: "When therefore his fellow slaves saw what had happened, they were very angry; and they went and explained to their master all that had happened.

entries.title: Matthew 18:32
segments: "Immediately his master summoned him and said: "'You wicked slave! I forgave you all that debt because you implored me.

entries.title: Matthew 18:33
segments: "'Ought not you also to have had pity on your fellow slave, just as I had pity on you?'

entries.title: Matthew 18:34
segments: "Then in hot anger his master handed him over to the torturers, until he should pay him all his debt.

entries.title: Matthew 18:35
segments: "So will my heavenly Father do to you also, unless from your heart each one of you forgive his brother."
